notes.title: Release Notes for Language Update
notes.notes:
This update adds the fan translations to the game so there's no need to install them manually anymore. 

Changes:

 Three languages: Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish Castellano
 Limited option for fullscreen (1920x1080 only)
 Link to the sequel in main menu and credits

notes.title: Ignis Universia Patch 1 Released
notes.notes: New patch was released that should help with taking the screenhots. There is now a new option button in the menu screen that changes which keys advance the dialogue. The options are the old mode (all keys + mouse) or a set of keys (space, enter and c). This does not affect any other controls in the game, only the dialogue.

notes.title: MacOS Version Upcoming!
notes.notes:
We're now working (well, Arto is) on the Mac build and it's starting to look good. There are some small bugs still (like the cursor you see in the picture), but they should be ironed out soon enough.
